# Alice Agent
> Open-source AI agent that runs locally, remembers context, and handles code, tasks, and creativity without sending your workflow to the cloud.

## Main pages
- [Home / English](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/): Alice Agent — your AI teammate, on your machine
- [Home / Español](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/es/): Alice Agent — tu compañera IA, en tu máquina
- [Home / Italiano](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/it/): Alice Agent — la tua compagna IA, sulla tua macchina
- [Features](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/features/): persistent memory, web browsing, scheduled tasks, secure sandboxing, skills, multi-agent Kanban, web dashboard, first-class CLI
- [Skills catalog](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/skills/): the 85 bundled skills, searchable and filterable — plus 600+ more via the Skills Hub
- [Model catalog](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/models/): curated models for OpenRouter and Nous Portal pickers
- [Automation blueprints](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/automation/): 14 ready-to-use cron blueprints — morning briefings, mail monitors, weekly reviews
- [FAQ](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/faq/): common questions — providers, local models, cost, security, memory vs skills
- [Docs](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/docs/): installation, configuration, skills, plugins, gateway, cron jobs
- [Blog](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/en/blog/): insights on AI agents, local-first architecture, building with Alice
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Stuko0/alice-agent): source code, releases, issues
- [Install script](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/install.sh): one-line installer

## Full documentation
- [Getting Started](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/getting-started/quickstart): install to first chat in under 5 minutes
- [Installation](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): Linux, macOS, WSL2, native Windows, Android via Termux
- [Features overview](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/overview): everything Alice can do
- [Tools](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/tools): what tools exist and how toolsets work
- [Skills system](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/skills): on-demand knowledge documents and the Skills Hub
- [Memory](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/memory): MEMORY.md, USER.md, session search
- [Cron jobs](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/cron): schedule automated tasks with natural language
- [Delegation](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/delegation): spawn isolated child agents for parallel work
- [Kanban multi-agent](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/features/kanban): SQLite-backed task board for multiple profiles
- [Messaging platforms](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/messaging/): Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, Matrix, and 15+ more
- [Configuration](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/configuration): config.yaml, providers, models, API keys
- [Security](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/user-guide/security): approval model, container isolation, best practices
- [CLI reference](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/reference/cli-commands): all commands
- [Model providers](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/integrations/providers): OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local servers
- [Skills catalog (full)](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/reference/skills-catalog): all bundled skills documented
- [Optional skills catalog](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/reference/optional-skills-catalog): 100+ installable skills
- [FAQ & Troubleshooting (full)](https://alice-agent.stuko.dev/docs/reference/faq): extended answers

## Key facts
- Open source, MIT license
- Runs locally: CLI and desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux)
- Model-agnostic: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, Nous Portal, or local Ollama / llama.cpp / vLLM
- 85 bundled skills + 600+ installable; agent creates its own skills as it works
- Persistent memory, plugins, cron jobs, subagent delegation
- Gateway to 21+ messaging platforms: Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and more
